description: Mada hii inahusu matumizi sahihi ya lugha kulingana na muktadha, ikijumuisha rejista mbalimbali, lugha ya heshima na adabu, misimu, lugha ya kawaida na lahaja za Kiswahili.

mcq.questionText: Neno 'rejista' katika lugha lina maana gani?

options.text: Aina ya lugha inayotumika kulingana na mahali au shughuli fulani

mcq.explanation: A register (rejista) is a variety of language used according to a particular setting, occupation or situation.

mcq.questionText: Maneno kama 'kipimo cha damu', 'sindano' na 'dawa' yanahusiana zaidi na rejista ya wapi?
mcq.explanation: Words like blood test, injection and medicine belong to the hospital register.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi 'Mahakama imeahirisha kesi hadi tarehe nyingine' inatumia rejista ya wapi?
mcq.explanation: Words such as court, adjourned and case are part of the court (legal) register.

mcq.questionText: Lugha ya 'Karibu, bei ni nafuu, chukua hii hapa, punguza kidogo' inasikika zaidi mahali gani?
mcq.explanation: Bargaining and inviting customers with phrases about price reflects the market register.

mcq.questionText: Ipi kati ya sentensi zifuatazo inaonyesha lugha ya heshima na adabu?

options.text: Tafadhali, naomba unisaidie kubeba mzigo huu.

mcq.explanation: Using 'please' and 'I request your help' shows politeness and good manners.

mcq.questionText: Neno 'misimu' lina maana gani katika lugha?

options.text: Maneno yasiyo rasmi yanayotumiwa na kundi fulani la watu
Maneno ya lugha za kigeni pekee

mcq.explanation: Slang (misimu) are informal words used by a particular group of people, often the youth.

mcq.questionText: Katika misimu, neno 'mzee' au 'buda' mara nyingi humaanisha nani?

options.text: Baba au mtu mzima wa kiume

mcq.explanation: In Tanzanian slang, 'buda' or 'mzee' commonly refers to one's father or an older man.

options.text: Lugha za kigeni zinazoingizwa katika Kiswahili
Aina mbalimbali za Kiswahili zinazozungumzwa katika maeneo tofauti

mcq.explanation: Dialects (lahaja) are the different varieties of Kiswahili spoken in different regions.

mcq.questionText: Ipi kati ya zifuatazo ni mfano wa lahaja ya Kiswahili?
mcq.explanation: Kiunguja, spoken in Zanzibar, is one of the recognised dialects of Kiswahili.

mcq.questionText: Mwanafunzi anapozungumza na mwalimu darasani, ni lugha ipi inayofaa kutumika?

options.text: Lugha ya heshima na ya kawaida fasaha

mcq.explanation: When addressing a teacher, a student should use respectful and standard language appropriate to school.

mcq.questionText: Kwa nini ni muhimu kutumia lugha kulingana na muktadha?

options.text: Ili ujumbe ueleweke vizuri na kuonyesha heshima
Ili kuonyesha kuwa unajua misimu mingi

mcq.explanation: Matching language to context ensures the message is understood and shows appropriate respect.

mcq.questionText: Neno la misimu 'mshikaji' lina maana gani katika lugha ya kawaida?
mcq.explanation: The slang word 'mshikaji' means a close friend in ordinary language.

mcq.questionText: Maneno 'mshtakiwa', 'hakimu' na 'ushahidi' ni ya rejista gani?
mcq.explanation: Accused, magistrate and evidence are terms belonging to the court register.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi ipi inafaa zaidi kutumika unapomwomba mzee msaada?

options.text: Shikamoo babu, naomba unipe maji ya kunywa.

mcq.explanation: Greeting an elder with 'shikamoo' and using 'please' demonstrates respect and good manners.

mcq.questionText: Tofauti kuu kati ya misimu na lahaja ni ipi?

options.text: Misimu hutumiwa na kundi fulani na hubadilika haraka, lahaja huzungumzwa na jamii ya eneo na ni za kudumu zaidi
Misimu ni lugha rasmi, lahaja ni lugha ya mtaani
Misimu ni za kigeni, lahaja ni za asili pekee

mcq.explanation: Slang is used by a specific group and changes quickly, while a dialect is a regional variety that is more stable over time.

tf.questionText: Rejista ni aina ya lugha inayotumika kulingana na muktadha au shughuli fulani.
tf.explanation: A register is indeed a language variety used according to context or activity.

tf.questionText: Misimu ni lugha rasmi inayofaa kutumika mahakamani.
tf.explanation: Slang is informal and is not appropriate for formal settings such as a court.

tf.questionText: Salamu 'shikamoo' hutumiwa na mdogo kumsalimia mtu mkubwa kwa heshima.
tf.explanation: 'Shikamoo' is used by a younger person to respectfully greet an older one.

tf.questionText: Lahaja zote za Kiswahili huzungumzwa kwa namna inayofanana kabisa bila tofauti yoyote.
tf.explanation: Dialects differ from one another in pronunciation and some vocabulary.

tf.questionText: Lugha ya heshima na adabu ni muhimu unapozungumza na wazazi, walimu na wazee.
tf.explanation: Polite and respectful language is expected when addressing parents, teachers and elders.

tf.questionText: Kiunguja na Kimvita ni mifano ya lahaja za Kiswahili.
tf.explanation: Both Kiunguja (Zanzibar) and Kimvita (Mombasa) are recognised dialects of Kiswahili.

tf.questionText: Maneno 'sindano', 'kidonge' na 'wodi' ni ya rejista ya sokoni.
tf.explanation: Injection, tablet and ward belong to the hospital register, not the market.

tf.questionText: Misimu hubadilika haraka kadiri muda unavyopita.
tf.explanation: Slang words change quickly over time as new ones are coined.

tf.questionText: Ni sahihi kutumia misimu ya rafiki zako unapojibu maswali ya mtihani wa Kiswahili.
tf.explanation: Examinations require standard language, not slang used among friends.

tf.questionText: Kutumia lugha isiyofaa kwa muktadha kunaweza kusababisha ujumbe usieleweke vizuri.
tf.explanation: Using language unsuited to the context can cause misunderstanding of the message.

summary.questionText: Lugha ya heshima na adabu hutumika lini?
summary.correctAnswer: Hutumika unapozungumza na wazazi, walimu, wazee na watu wenye vyeo.
summary.explanation: Respectful and polite language is used when addressing parents, teachers, elders and people of rank.

summary.correctAnswer: Shikamoo, ambayo mdogo humsalimia mkubwa, naye hujibu marahaba.
summary.explanation: 'Shikamoo' is the respectful greeting from a junior to a senior, answered with 'marahaba'.

summary.questionText: Kwa nini tunatumia lugha kulingana na muktadha?
summary.correctAnswer: Ili ujumbe ueleweke vizuri na kuonyesha heshima inayostahili.
summary.explanation: Matching language to context aids clear communication and shows due respect.
Kiunguja, Kimvita, Kiamu and Kipemba are well-known dialects of Kiswahili.

summary.questionText: Tofauti kati ya lugha ya kawaida na misimu.
summary.correctAnswer: Lugha ya kawaida hueleweka na watu wengi, ilhali misimu hueleweka na kundi fulani tu.
summary.explanation: Ordinary language is understood by most people, whereas slang is understood mainly by a specific group.

hoq.questionText: Hospitalini, daktari anamwambia mgonjwa: 'Bei ya kidonge hiki ni nafuu, punguza wasiwasi, chukua mbili asubuhi.' Kuna tatizo gani la kirejista katika kauli hii?

options.text: Imechanganya rejista ya sokoni ('bei', 'punguza') na ile ya hospitalini
Imetumia lugha ya heshima kupita kiasi

hoq.explanation: The market-register words 'bei' and 'punguza' are mixed into a hospital context, making the register inconsistent and inappropriate.

hoq.questionText: Mwanafunzi anaandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu mkuu akianza: 'Mambo vipi mkuu, niko fiti.' Ni kanuni ipi ya matumizi ya lugha aliyovunja?

options.text: Ametumia misimu na lugha isiyo rasmi katika muktadha unaohitaji lugha rasmi ya heshima
Ametumia lahaja ya Kipemba badala ya Kiunguja
Ametumia lugha ya heshima kupita kiasi

hoq.explanation: A formal letter to a head teacher demands respectful, standard language; using slang like 'mambo vipi' and 'niko fiti' breaks this contextual rule.

hoq.questionText: Kwa nini misimu mara nyingi haiwezi kueleweka na watu wa rika au maeneo tofauti, tofauti na lahaja?

options.text: Kwa sababu misimu huundwa na kundi maalum, hubadilika haraka, na hubeba maana iliyofichika kwa kundi hilo
Kwa sababu misimu ni lugha rasmi inayofundishwa shuleni
Kwa sababu misimu ni sehemu ya sarufi ya Kiswahili sanifu
Kwa sababu misimu huandikwa katika kamusi zote

hoq.explanation: Slang is created by a specific group, changes rapidly and carries meanings hidden to outsiders, so it is less widely understood than relatively stable regional dialects.
